concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-articles-moneris-change-your-bank-account]] - 2026-09-16 Braintree-hosted Moneris account-route snapshot for requesting a bank-account change through a Control Panel document upload, with authorized-signer, Canadian business-checking, six-month bank-letter and CAD/USD fee/deposit qualifications; not evidence that an API route is absent, a change or payout completed, or current independent Moneris policy
warnings: This is Braintree-hosted snapshot evidence for a Moneris-routed account, not current independent Moneris authority or a sibling processor route.
The Control Panel upload route does not establish API absence, document acceptance, completed account change, settlement or deposit arrival.
